name: spawn
description: Run Claude on any model the local Superagent Gateway serves, across five surfaces. A headless lens returns a different-vendor answer as one JSON object on stdout, with failure classes distinguishable by exit code. An interactive launch materializes an attachable session on a named alias and prints a resume handle that never carries the token. A background agent runs unattended under a fixed repo-bounded permission ceiling and is judged against a contract written up front — deliverables measured against a pre-job baseline, an optional verify command the supervisor runs itself — never against the model's account of its own work. A team runs several named members at once, each in its own worktree on its own alias against its own contract, dispatched in bounded rounds from one record on disk that carries every member's probed state, its cause of failure and the model that actually answered it. The plugin owns its own gateway control layer (liveness by probing the model-list endpoint, idempotent locked start, append-only log, runtime install-dir resolution) and setup rewrites the existing gw wrapper to delegate to it and to read its token from the Keychain instead of carrying a hardcoded one.
